failures_and_limits: Initial pool.terminate hit AppArmor PermissionError13; replaced by cooperative Event cancellation, close/join, bounded exit watchdog. Audits rerun successfully.
Eight-thread multi-process screen became slower; p4b stopped and pending reverse-order cases cancelled. p4a exited137 without a complete result and is recorded as incomplete in the failure evidence.
First window acceptance uncovered psycopg literal-percent query bug; fixed and rerun. Second uncovered old19:00 database guard; migration010 added and rerun.
Unrestricted Qwen picked different recipes and gradient counts; ABBA is operational evidence, not a controlled hardware-only comparison.
Fixed-input control replays actual GPU HYPOTHESES and TOOL_FEEDBACK requests but freezes branch directions; it measures orchestration/compute, not research proposal quality.
All comparisons are finite measurements, not a sustained throughput guarantee or evidence of50% lottery accuracy.
Final review corrected formal prediction sealed_at parameter binding; validated separately without bypassing real qualification.
Early raw CPU counters excluded live persistent-pool fitters; do not compare their cpu_seconds. Production accounting now reads cgroup cpu.stat.
